_comment: Configuration for the Salesforce Guest-User API Exposure Auditor. Only run this against orgs you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
_guest_session_comment: OPTIONAL. If you want to test as an authenticated GUEST user of an Experience Cloud site (the realistic attack path), obtain a guest session id/token the same way an anonymous visitor would (e.g. by loading the community page and capturing the 'sid' cookie via browser devtools, or via a documented guest login flow). Leave blank to only test fully unauthenticated requests.
_discovery_comment: If true, the script calls the global describe endpoint (using guest_session_id if provided, otherwise unauthenticated) to enumerate every object visible and tests all of them. If false, only 'standard_objects' below is tested.
_apex_comment: Custom Apex REST endpoints to probe for unauthenticated exposure. Paths are relative to /services/apexrest/. Add your org's known custom endpoints here.
_soql_comment: Fields to try selecting per object during the read-access probe. 'Id' is always attempted first as a safe minimal probe.
